verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI offers explicit concurrency/scale features—parallel crawling, Docker+FastAPI server, browser pool monitoring dashboard, proxy chains/retry, multi-URL batch configs, and crash-recovery/resume for long-running deep crawls—suggesting real support for many concurrent sessions at scale. However, evidence is mostly vendor docs/GitHub feature lists without independent benchmarks, and community feedback notes users must build their own production policy layer (rate limiting, bot mitigation) to run reliably at scale.
